name: server
description: YS-Codebase Persistent Server & Warm Worker Subsystem
onboarding: Start background daemon (or use --console in IDE background task): python yscb.py server start
Inspect live server & worker status: python yscb.py server status
Stop daemon and view session summary: python yscb.py server stop

release.summary: 對齊背景工作行程預熱階段之虛擬工作目錄，消除首次啟動預熱阻塞
